content.description: Draft report content to render into a PDF file.

outputPath.description: Target PDF path for generated draft artifact.

title.description: Optional report title rendered in the generated draft.

outputPath.description: Optional output path for edited PDF.

provider.description: Optional provider selector for edit execution. The installed nano-pdf CLI currently supports only Gemini-backed editing.

model.description: Optional model identifier for edit execution. Non-Gemini overrides are rejected by the current bridge preflight because the installed nano-pdf CLI hard-codes Gemini.

baseUrl.description: Optional provider endpoint override. Present for future local-provider compatibility; the current installed nano-pdf CLI does not support base URL overrides.

apiKeyEnvName.description: Optional environment variable name holding the provider API key. Defaults to GEMINI_API_KEY for Gemini and OPENAI_API_KEY for local HTTP-compatible fallback routes.

preflightOnly.description: Optional flag to validate provider/model/baseUrl resolution and connectivity without performing the edit.

theme.description: Optional fallback renderer theme preset. Supported values: executive, financial, market, healthcare, energy, technology. If omitted, BlazeClaw selects a theme heuristically from the report title, metadata, and section content.
